class.name: OcgGceMakelin
class.brief_description: This class implements construction algorithms for `gp_Lin`. Supported constructions include: - line from axis placement; - line from point and direction; - parallel line through point; - line through two points.

method.name: from_1
method.description: Creates a line located along the axis A1.

method.name: from_2
method.description: is the location point (origin) of the line and is the direction of the line.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates a line parallel to input line and passing through a point.

method.name: from_4
method.description: Creates a line passing through two points.

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the constructed line. Exceptions StdFail_NotDone is raised if no line is constructed.

method.name: Operator
method.description: Alias for Value() returning a copy.
